pop.total.label: Total population
pop.total.definition: All persons enumerated in Census 2011 within the district's 2011 boundary.
pop.total.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)

pop.households.label: Households
pop.households.definition: Number of normal households enumerated in Census 2011.
pop.households.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)

pop.avg_household_size.label: Average household size
pop.avg_household_size.definition: Persons per household. Total population divided by number of households.
pop.avg_household_size.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)

pop.st_share.label: Scheduled Tribe share of population
pop.st_share.definition: Persons enumerated as Scheduled Tribe as a percentage of total population. Denominator is total population, not population aged 7+.
pop.st_share.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)
caveats: Scheduled Tribe status is a constitutional classification of communities, not a measure of where Fifth Schedule Scheduled Areas are declared. A high share is a screening indicator only; it is not a legal determination.

pop.sc_share.label: Scheduled Caste share of population
pop.sc_share.definition: Persons enumerated as Scheduled Caste as a percentage of total population.
pop.sc_share.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)

pop.child_share.label: Children aged 0-6
pop.child_share.definition: Population aged 0 to 6 as a percentage of total population.
pop.child_share.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)

pop.literacy_rate.label: Literacy rate
pop.literacy_rate.definition: Literates as a percentage of population aged 7 and above. This is the official Census of India definition. It is NOT literates over total population, which yields a materially lower and non-comparable figure.
pop.literacy_rate.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)

pop.age7plus.label: Population aged 7 and above
pop.age7plus.definition: Total population less population aged 0 to 6. The Census literacy denominator.
pop.age7plus.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)

pop.sex_ratio.label: Sex ratio
pop.sex_ratio.definition: Females per 1,000 males, the convention used by the Census of India.
pop.sex_ratio.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)

work.total_workers.label: Total workers
work.total_workers.definition: All persons recorded as main or marginal workers in Census 2011. A main worker worked six months or more in the reference year; a marginal worker worked less than six months.
work.total_workers.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)

work.participation_rate.label: Work participation rate
work.participation_rate.definition: Total workers as a percentage of total population, the Census of India definition. Denominator is the whole population including children, so this is not comparable to a labour-force participation rate computed over working-age population.
work.participation_rate.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)

work.land_dependent_share.label: Workers dependent on land
work.land_dependent_share.definition: Cultivators plus agricultural labourers, main and marginal combined, as a percentage of total workers. This is the share of the working population whose income derives directly from land, and is the population most directly exposed to land acquisition.
work.land_dependent_share.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)
caveats: Counts workers, not households, and excludes those dependent on forest produce or common land who are not enumerated as cultivators or agricultural labourers.

work.cultivator_share.label: Cultivators
work.cultivator_share.definition: Cultivators (main and marginal) as a percentage of total workers. A cultivator works land they own or hold.
work.cultivator_share.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)

work.ag_labourer_share.label: Agricultural labourers
work.ag_labourer_share.definition: Agricultural labourers (main and marginal) as a percentage of total workers. An agricultural labourer works another's land for wages and holds no land right, so is typically not compensated under land acquisition even when displaced from their livelihood.
work.ag_labourer_share.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)

work.marginal_share.label: Marginal workers
work.marginal_share.definition: Workers employed less than six months in the reference year, as a percentage of total workers. A high share indicates insecure or seasonal employment.
work.marginal_share.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)

work.household_industry_share.label: Household industry workers
work.household_industry_share.definition: Workers in household industry (main and marginal) as a percentage of total workers.
work.household_industry_share.source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract (via SHRUG v5.0)

infra.phc_doctors_sanctioned.label: Primary Health Centre doctor posts sanctioned
infra.phc_doctors_sanctioned.definition: Doctor positions sanctioned at Primary Health Centres in the district's rural areas.
infra.phc_doctors_sanctioned.source: Census of India 2011, Village Directory (via SHRUG v5.0)

infra.phc_doctors_in_post.label: Primary Health Centre doctor posts filled
infra.phc_doctors_in_post.definition: Doctor positions actually filled at Primary Health Centres in the district's rural areas.
infra.phc_doctors_in_post.source: Census of India 2011, Village Directory (via SHRUG v5.0)

infra.phc_doctor_vacancy_rate.label: Primary Health Centre doctor vacancy
infra.phc_doctor_vacancy_rate.definition: Sanctioned doctor posts not filled, as a percentage of sanctioned posts. A ratio of two columns from the same source family, so it is robust to the unit ambiguity that makes the raw facility counts unusable.
infra.phc_doctor_vacancy_rate.source: Census of India 2011, Village Directory (via SHRUG v5.0)
caveats: Rural areas only. Districts with no sanctioned posts return no value rather than zero.

In 21 districts the source records more doctors in post than posts sanctioned. That is an internal inconsistency in the Village Directory, not a staffing surplus, so the rate is withheld for those districts while both raw counts are still shown.

infra.hospitals.label: Hospitals
infra.hospitals.definition: All hospitals recorded in the Village Directory for the district's rural areas.
infra.hospitals.source: Census of India 2011, Village Directory (via SHRUG v5.0)
caveats: Rural areas only. Urban facilities are not counted.

infra.primary_schools_gov.label: Government primary schools
infra.primary_schools_gov.definition: Government primary schools in the district's rural areas.
infra.primary_schools_gov.source: Census of India 2011, Village Directory (via SHRUG v5.0)

infra.middle_schools_gov.label: Government middle schools
infra.middle_schools_gov.definition: Government middle schools in the district's rural areas.
infra.middle_schools_gov.source: Census of India 2011, Village Directory (via SHRUG v5.0)
caveats: Some states do not use this category. Every one of Gujarat's 26 districts reports zero, because its primary schools run to standard 8, so there is no separate middle school to count. Where a measure is zero across an entire state the value is withheld rather than shown as zero, which would assert that the schools do not exist.

infra.secondary_schools_gov.label: Government secondary schools
infra.secondary_schools_gov.definition: Government secondary schools in the district's rural areas.
infra.secondary_schools_gov.source: Census of India 2011, Village Directory (via SHRUG v5.0)

secc.households.label: Rural households (SECC)
secc.households.definition: Rural households enumerated in the Socio Economic and Caste Census 2011 and matched to this area by SHRUG.
secc.households.source: Socio Economic and Caste Census 2011, rural, Ministry of Rural Development (via SHRUG v5.0)

secc.land_owning_share.label: Rural households owning land
secc.land_owning_share.definition: Share of rural households that own land, as recorded in SECC 2011. Rural households only; urban households are not in this table.
secc.land_owning_share.formula: 100 * sum(land_own_share * secc_hh) / sum(secc_hh), over sub-districts reporting it
secc.land_owning_share.source: Socio Economic and Caste Census 2011, rural, Ministry of Rural Development (via SHRUG v5.0)

secc.earner_over_5k_share.label: Rural households whose highest earner makes over ₹5,000 a month
secc.earner_over_5k_share.definition: Share of rural households whose highest-earning member has a monthly income greater than ₹5,000, as recorded in SECC 2011. The complement is the SECC deprivation marker most often cited: households whose highest earner makes ₹5,000 or less.
secc.earner_over_5k_share.formula: 100 * sum(inc_5k_plus_share * secc_hh) / sum(secc_hh), over sub-districts reporting it
secc.earner_over_5k_share.source: Socio Economic and Caste Census 2011, rural, Ministry of Rural Development (via SHRUG v5.0)

secc.manual_labour_share.label: Rural households living mainly on manual casual labour
secc.manual_labour_share.definition: Share of rural households whose main source of income is manual casual labour, as recorded in SECC 2011.
secc.manual_labour_share.formula: 100 * sum(inc_source_manlab_share * secc_hh) / sum(secc_hh), over sub-districts reporting it
secc.manual_labour_share.source: Socio Economic and Caste Census 2011, rural, Ministry of Rural Development (via SHRUG v5.0)

secc.salaried_share.label: Rural households with a salaried member
secc.salaried_share.definition: Share of rural households with any member in salaried employment (government, public or private sector), as recorded in SECC 2011.
secc.salaried_share.formula: 100 * sum(salary_any_share * secc_hh) / sum(secc_hh), over sub-districts reporting it
secc.salaried_share.source: Socio Economic and Caste Census 2011, rural, Ministry of Rural Development (via SHRUG v5.0)

definitions.secc.land_owning_share: 100 * sum(land_own_share * secc_hh) / sum(secc_hh), over sub-districts reporting it
definitions.secc.earner_over_5k_share: 100 * sum(inc_5k_plus_share * secc_hh) / sum(secc_hh), over sub-districts reporting it
definitions.secc.manual_labour_share: 100 * sum(inc_source_manlab_share * secc_hh) / sum(secc_hh), over sub-districts reporting it
definitions.secc.salaried_share: 100 * sum(salary_any_share * secc_hh) / sum(secc_hh), over sub-districts reporting it
